Skills Prompts GitHub

Example prompts

Things you can say to your AI coding agent (Claude Code, Antigravity, Devin, Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex, Gemini CLI…) for each skill. Install the skill, then just ask. The agent reads the skill's description and loads it when your request matches. To force a specific skill, start with Use the <skill-name> skill:.

Prompts come from examples/prompts.json. Add yours in a pull request.
